items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2 for whole-body humanoid control and multi-robot collaboration
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2：實現人形機器人全身控制與多機器人協作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a family of models enabling intelligent whole-body control for humanoids from feet to fingertips, advanced dexterity, and multi-robot teamwork. It includes the vision-language-action model Gemini Robotics 2, the embodied reasoning model Gemini Robotics ER 2 (available in public preview on Google AI Studio), and the on-device adaptive Gemini Robotics On-Device 2.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布推出 Gemini Robotics 2 模型家族，為人形機器人提供從腳到指尖的全身智能控制、高靈巧度操作，以及多機器人協作能力。包含視覺-語言-動作模型 Gemini Robotics 2、具身推理模型 Gemini Robotics ER 2（已在 Google AI Studio 公開預覽），以及可本地運行並快速適應新機體的 On-Device 2。
items_flat.analysis_en: This advances physical AI beyond tabletop tasks toward general-purpose robots usable in homes and workplaces. Key uncertainty remains real-world robustness, safety in unstructured environments, and how quickly partners can integrate the models into production hardware.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將物理 AI 從桌面任務推進至可實際應用於家庭與工作場所的通用機器人。關鍵不確定性包括真實世界穩健性、非結構化環境安全，以及合作夥伴將模型整合至量產硬體的速度。
items_flat.quote: From feet to fingertips — we are teaching robots intelligent whole-body control, fine dexterity, and teamwork to complete a broad range of complex tasks
items_flat.quote_zh: 從腳到指尖——我們正在教導機器人具備智能全身控制、精細靈巧度與團隊合作，以完成廣泛複雜任務

brief_en: Google DeepMind launched Gemini Robotics 2, enabling whole-body humanoid control, advanced dexterity, multi-robot collaboration and on-device adaptation. Quiet otherwise across OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, xAI and open-source labs in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2，實現人形機器人全身控制、高靈巧度、多機協作與本地適配。過去12小時其他大廠官方重大動態平靜。
